name: Flickr
label: Flickr API
description: Official Flickr REST (api_key query, format=json&nojsoncallback=1). photo_search, photo_get, people_get. photo_upload omitted (multipart + OAuth 1.0a not supported by OfficialApiNode). flickr.push is experimental Pro-only PubSubHubbub. Licence is per photo. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for Flickr. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"photo_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: photo_search | photo_get | people_get | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'photo_search'.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: photo_search sort. EXACT: date-posted-asc | date-posted-desc | date-taken-asc | date-taken-desc | interestingness-desc | interestingness-asc | relevance.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: photo_search | photo_get | people_get | trigger. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: 'photo_search'.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Flickr API key (query api_key). Public read. Commercial use may need Flickr permission. https://www.flickr.com/services/api/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
